lines.text: In King Darius's fourth year, the word of the LORD came to Zechariah, and Bethel's people sent men to plead.
The men from Bethel asked the priests and prophets whether to keep weeping and fasting in the fifth month.
The LORD asked whether their seventy years of fasting were really for Him, and recalled words spoken through the kings.
The LORD told them to administer true justice and not oppress the widow, the fatherless, the foreigner or the poor.
The LORD scattered them with a whirlwind into the wilderness of Sinai, and the land was left desolate.
